# Lectures

The directory contains the 14 scheduled class meetings. Labor Day, Fall Break, and the no-class repeated-measures week remain visible in the [complete timeline](../weeks/) but do not receive artificial lecture pages.

Only my original notes and permitted references will appear here. Instructor slides, readings, examples, recordings, data, and other restricted materials are not redistributed.
